# proxies_mixed.txt
# This is a realistic sample proxy list covering all formats your parser
# needs to handle. Lines starting with # are comments and should be skipped.

# --- Bare host:port (most common format from cheap providers) ---
192.168.1.1:8080
10.0.0.1:3128
203.0.113.42:8888

# --- Full URL format without credentials ---
http://198.51.100.10:8080
https://198.51.100.20:443
socks5://198.51.100.30:1080
socks4://198.51.100.40:1080

# --- Full URL format with credentials ---
http://user:password@198.51.100.50:8080
socks5://proxyuser:secret123@198.51.100.60:1080
https://admin:p@ssw0rd@198.51.100.70:443

# --- Colon-delimited with credentials (common export format) ---
198.51.100.80:8080:myuser:mypass
203.0.113.1:3128:scraper:hunter2

# --- Edge cases ---
# IPv6 (uncommon but real)
[2001:db8::1]:8080

# Blank lines below should be silently skipped


# --- Invalid lines (should be recorded as failures, not crash) ---
notaproxy
:8080
justahostname
ftp://198.51.100.90:21
